about.text: "edge cheese", a hard cheese produced in Friesland, with variants flavoured with cumin and cloves.

sources.text: PDO (not PGI), Friesland and Westerkwartier, pasteurised cow's milk. Minimum four weeks per secondary source; spec moisture limits at 12 days. Max 120 is typical, not from the spec. Variants Kanterkomijnekaas (cumin) and Kanternagelkaas (cumin and cloves); rind natural or coated
